name: Rizuhble's Glitter Gun Celeste
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-8,800 (levels 1-15). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Radiant Daggers T3, Shining Wonder unlocked. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Swift Striker. Ultimate (Shining Wonder) is available from Swift Striker.

items.name: High-Velocity Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Swift Striker completes 4,800 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Swift Striker completes 4.8k weapon in 4800 souls (~4.8 min), 4 purchases

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Fortitude, 12800 souls (~12.8 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Opening Rounds
items.caption: Temporary, sold when you buy Witchmail later. Upgrade of High-Velocity Rounds (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Swift Striker completes 4.8k weapon in 3200 souls (~3.2 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Kinetic Dash
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Swift Striker completes 1,600 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Swift Striker completes 4.8k weapon in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Swift Striker
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 18 to 46% weapon damage. Temporary, sold when you buy Spellslinger later.

items.name: Extra Health
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Fortitude, 8000 souls (~8.0 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Quicksilver Reload
items.caption: Imbued on Radiant Daggers: the imbue charges up over 18s; the charged use reloads the clip and gives 10% fire rate for 12s.

items.name: Mystic Regeneration
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Radiant Regeneration completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Radiant Regeneration completes 4.8k spirit in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 8,800-24,000 (levels 15-27). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Light Eater T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Radiant Daggers, impact damage) grows from 149 to 202. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Radiant Regeneration, vitality 4.8k at Fortitude.

items.name: Radiant Regeneration
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 spirit power. Upgrade of Mystic Regeneration (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Healing Booster
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Fortitude completes 2,400 souls on. Upgrade of Extra Regen (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: imminent: Fortitude completes 4.8k vitality in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Fortitude
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Extra Health (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Mercurial Magnum
items.caption: Imbued on Radiant Daggers: the imbue charges up over 14s; the charged use reloads the clip and gives 22% fire rate for 12s. Takes spirit from 4,800 to 9,600 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 52 spirit power. Upgrade of Quicksilver Reload (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

items.name: Extra Charge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Radiant Daggers (3 to 4).

items.name: Rapid Recharge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Radiant Daggers (4 to 5). Takes spirit from 10,400 to 12,800 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power. Upgrade of Extra Charge (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Spirit Lifesteal
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 24,000-54,400 (levels 27-36). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Dazzling Trick T3, Shining Wonder T3.

items.name: Spiritual Overflow
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 4,800 to 11,200 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 46 to 74% weapon damage.

items.name: Spirit Rend
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: swap_candidate)

items.name: Unstoppable
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 11,200 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 38 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Toxic Bullets
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 14,400 to 17,600 invested: bonus 74 to 86% weapon damage.

items.name: Witchmail
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 11,200 to 17,600 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Spellslinger
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Fortitude? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Healing Booster.
sections.desc: Dying after Fortitude? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Healing Booster.

items.name: Ethereal Shift
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: They keep jumping you and you can't get out.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun carry is melting you.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Bullet Resilience
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Two or more gun heroes keep hitting you.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Their spirit damage keeps hurting you after the hit, like Infernus burn or Seven's ult.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Hexes and slows stop you getting away.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult or Grey Talon's charged arrow.

items.name: Ricochet
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 20,800 to 24,000 invested: bonus 86 to 100% weapon damage.

items.name: Inhibitor
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 17,600 to 24,000 invested: bonus 54 to 60 vitality bonus.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Healing Tempo
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Healing Booster for 4,800 more souls: bonus fire rate 0 to 35; tech resist 0 to 10..
